answer.design_quote: Meta-analysis was conducted when at least two studies provided sufficient data for the same intervention and outcome. For the primary outcome (delirium incidence), the number of delirium events reported during the intervention period or at discharge was used to calculate pooled risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs).
answer.k_quote: Overall, 12 RCTs involving 2,747 patients were included.
